parsed.text: Using the supplied coordinate system and times: Panel p0 current estimates (copied prior records) show node n0 with a strong blue peak at cell (0,1) and a strong red peak at (0,3). In p0 current, nodes n1–n3 have both roles uniform across all 16 cells. Under p0 candidate commands: k0 changes n3 to four moderate blue peaks at (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and four moderate red peaks at (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); k1 leaves n3 uniform; k2 makes n3 sharply peaked (blue at (1,2), red at (0,1)). Panel p1 current estimates match p0 for n0 (blue (0,1), red (0,3)) and have n1–n3 uniform. In p1 candidates, k0 alters n3 to the same moderate four-cell pattern as p0 k0, while k1 and k2 make n3 sharply peaked (blue at (1,2), red at (0,1)). Copied records are prior estimates; conditional command records are alternative estimates, not events that have occurred.
